model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between co-occurrence number and accuracy (ACC) for several conditions. The x-axis is labeled "Co-occurrence Number" and uses a logarithmic scale ranging from 0 to 1000, with tick labels at 1, 10, 100, and 1000. The y-axis is labeled "ACC (%)" and uses a linear scale ranging from 40 to 65, with tick labels at 40, 45, 50, 55, 60, and 65. The "Base" condition is represented by a black solid line with circular markers, starting at 39.3% at a co-occurrence number of 0 and increasing to 51.5% at a co-occurrence number of 1000. The "FT" condition is represented by a blue solid line with triangular markers, starting at 38.3% at a co-occurrence number of 0 and increasing to 50.5% at a co-occurrence number of 1000. The "IKE" condition is represented by a red solid line with triangular markers, starting at 44.2% at a co-occurrence number of 0 and increasing to 49.8% at a co-occurrence number of 1000. The "MEMIT" condition is represented by a purple solid line with diamond markers, starting at 50.2% at a co-occurrence number of 0 and increasing to 52.8% at a co-occurrence number of 1000. The "ROME" condition is represented by a green solid line with square markers, starting at 50.3% at a co-occurrence number of 0 and increasing to 64.3% at a co-occurrence number of 1000.
